stages.completion_condition: Return exactly TEKROO_ORGANIZATIONAL_RESULT followed by one JSON object containing only schema_version=1.0.0, result_type=FEATURE_REFINEMENT, acceptance_criteria_disposition=PRESERVE_SUBMITTED, clarification_questions (an empty array when none), and priority (LOW, NORMAL, HIGH, or CRITICAL). The refinement preserves submitted acceptance criteria and makes material ambiguity explicit.

Return exactly TEKROO_ORGANIZATIONAL_RESULT followed by one JSON object containing only schema_version=1.0.0, result_type=FEATURE_SPECIFICATION, stories [{title, description, acceptance_criteria, priority}], and design_constraints. Priority is LOW, NORMAL, HIGH, or CRITICAL. The smallest finite set of independently useful stories covers every submitted acceptance criterion.

Return exactly TEKROO_ORGANIZATIONAL_RESULT followed by one JSON object containing only schema_version=1.0.0, result_type=FEATURE_PLAN, architecture, design_decisions, assumptions, and tasks. Each task contains only story_index, title, description, acceptance_criteria, backward depends_on indexes, empty validates, purpose=IMPLEMENTATION, complexity, risk, critical_path, attempt_limit, and review_round_limit. The plan is repository-grounded, acyclic, uses true dependencies, preserves layer ownership, and contains only work needed for the accepted feature.
